{{Current events|year=2026|month=04|day=13|content=

<!-- All news items below this line -->
'''Armed conflicts and attacks'''
*[[Middle Eastern crisis (2023–present)|Middle Eastern crisis]]
**[[2026 Iran war]]
***[[2026 Strait of Hormuz crisis]]
****[[2026 Strait of Hormuz campaign]], [[Naval blockade of Iran]]
*****In a notice to seafarers, the [[United States Central Command|U.S. Central Command]] announces that a [[blockade]] of Iranian ports is now in effect, with all unauthorized vessels in the [[Gulf of Oman]] and the [[Arabian Sea]] east of the [[Strait of Hormuz]] subject to interdiction. [https://aje.news/czjcze?update=4488691 (Al Jazeera)]
****Three ships successfully cross the Strait of Hormuz since the blockade was announced, including [[Marshall Islands]]-flagged vessel ''New Future'', [[Vietnam]]-flagged ''NV Sunshine'', and [[Panama]]-flagged tanker ''Auroura'', which was recently [[International sanctions against Iran|sanctioned]] by the [[United States]] for its links to [[Petroleum industry in Iran|Iranian oil]] trading. [https://www.bloomberg.com/news/articles/2026-04-13/two-oil-tankers-attempt-hormuz-exit-after-us-announces-blockade?embedded-checkout=true (Bloomberg)] [https://caspianpost.com/economics/tankers-make-first-attempt-to-cross-hormuz-strait-amid-us-blockade-warnings (''Caspian Post'')]  
***[[2026 Iran war ceasefire]]
****[[Pakistan]]i [[Prime Minister of Pakistan|prime minister]] [[Shehbaz Sharif]] says that the [[ceasefire]] is still in force and efforts are still underway to end the war despite the [[Islamabad Talks|recent talks]] ending without an agreement. [https://www.arabnews.pk/node/2639781/pakistan (''Arab News PK'')]
**[[Hezbollah–Israel conflict]]
***[[2026 Lebanon war]]
****[[Battle of Bint Jbeil (2026)]]
*****The [[Israeli Ground Forces|Israeli army]] claims to have killed over 100 [[Hezbollah]] fighters during the battle in [[Bint Jbeil]]. [https://www.aljazeera.com/news/2026/4/13/at-least-six-killed-in-israeli-strikes-in-southern-lebanon (Al Jazeera)]
****At least six people are killed by [[Israel]]i [[airstrike]]s across [[southern Lebanon]], including at an [[International Red Cross]] location in [[Tyre, Lebanon|Tyre]]. [https://www.aljazeera.com/news/2026/4/13/at-least-six-killed-in-israeli-strikes-in-southern-lebanon (Al Jazeera)]
*[[Operation Southern Spear]], [[United States strikes on alleged drug traffickers during Operation Southern Spear]]
**Two people are killed in an [[airstrike]] carried out by the [[United States Navy]] against an alleged drug boat in the [[Pacific Ocean|eastern Pacific]]. [https://www.reuters.com/world/us-kills-two-men-strike-eastern-pacific-2026-04-13/ (Reuters)]
*[[Haitian conflict]]
**Seven people are killed after a [[Haitian National Police|police]] station in [[Marigot, Haiti|Marigot]], [[Sud-Est (department)|Sud-Est]], [[Haiti]], was [[Arson|burned]] during a gang attack. [https://apnews.com/article/haiti-gangs-seguin-attack-killings-90e638b676d181dc63359c8c92bacf4a (AP)]
*[[Insurgency in the Maghreb (2002–present)|Insurgency in the Maghreb]]
**Two [[Suicide attack|suicide bombers]] blow themselves up near a police station in [[Blida]], [[Algeria]], wounding several people. [https://www.lemonde.fr/en/le-monde-africa/article/2026/04/14/pope-s-first-day-in-algeria-marred-by-failed-suicide-attack-near-algiers_6752401_124.html (''Le Monde'')]
*[[Insurgency in Khyber Pakhtunkhwa]]
**A [[Khyber Pakhtunkhwa Police|policeman]] is killed and four others are injured during an [[ambush]] against a [[polio]] [[Polio vaccine|vaccination]] team in [[Hangu, Pakistan|Hangu]], [[Khyber Pakhtunkhwa]], [[Pakistan]]. [https://dunyanews.tv/amp/english/945683.php (Dunya News)]

'''Business and economy'''
*[[2026 Cuban crisis]]
**[[Spain|Spanish]] airline [[Iberia (airline)|Iberia]] announces the suspension of flights to [[Cuba]] from June to late October due to [[Energy in Cuba|fuel supply]] constraints and reduced passenger demand linked to the U.S.-imposed oil blockade of the country. The airline states that it plans to resume operations in November if conditions improve. [https://infra.economictimes.indiatimes.com/amp/news/aviation/iberia-to-suspend-flights-to-cuba-amid-us-fuel-blockade/130237226 (AFP via ''The Economic Times'')]
*[[2026 Philippine energy crisis]]
**[[Philippines|Philippine]] [[President of the Philippines|president]] [[Bongbong Marcos]] suspends [[excise]]s on [[kerosene]] and [[liquefied petroleum gas]] to reduce household fuel costs amid [[2026 Iran war fuel crisis|rising global oil prices]] linked to the [[2026 Iran war|Iran war]]. [https://www.reuters.com/business/energy/philippines-marcos-suspends-taxes-fuel-products-2026-04-13/ (Reuters)]
*[[Chinese property sector crisis (2020–present)|Chinese property sector crisis]]
**A [[Judicial system of China|court]] in [[Beijing]], [[China]], orders the [[liquidation]] of [[Zhongzhi Enterprise Group]] and more than 300 affiliated companies through a consolidated [[Bankruptcy in China|bankruptcy process]], with [[creditor]]s instructed to submit [[Cause of action|claims]] by June 10. [https://www.reuters.com/world/asia-pacific/china-court-orders-bankruptcy-liquidation-zhongzhi-group-316-affiliates-2026-04-13/ (Reuters)]
*[[Chevron Corporation]] signs two agreements with the [[Government of Venezuela|government]] of [[Venezuela]] to expand its operations in the oil-producing [[Orinoco Belt]] region. [https://www.reuters.com/business/energy/chevron-shell-sign-agreements-oil-gas-areas-venezuela-sources-say-2026-04-13/ (Reuters)]

'''Disasters and accidents'''
*Eleven people are killed after a cement mixer truck collided with a van in [[Thane district]], [[India]]. [https://indianexpress.com/article/cities/mumbai/thane-road-accident-cement-truck-eco-van-11-dead-10634308/ (The Indian Express)]
*Five people are killed after two cars collided  into each other head-on in [[Kings County, California|Kings County]], [[California]], [[United States]]. [https://kmph.com/news/local/five-killed-in-head-on-crash-on-hwy-41-in-kings-co-county-highway-york-avenue%7Ctitle=Five (Fox News)]

'''Health and environment'''
*[[Hippopotamuses in Colombia]]
**[[Colombia]]n [[Ministry of Environment and Sustainable Development (Colombia)|environment minister]] [[Irene Vélez Torres]] approves the [[culling|cull]] of dozens of wild [[Hippopotamus|hippos]] brought to the country by [[drug lord]] [[Pablo Escobar]] in the 1980s with Torres saying up to 80 will be killed out of an estimated population of about 200, citing the need to protect local villagers and [[Fauna of Colombia|native species]]. [https://apnews.com/article/colombia-hippos-escobar-culling-cf98a01c0f5a8b29ec255a75302f0f97 (AP)]

'''International relations'''
*[[Algeria–Holy See relations]], [[List of pastoral visits of Pope Leo XIV|Pastoral visits of Pope Leo XIV]]
**[[Pope Leo XIV]] arrives in [[Algiers]], marking the first [[papal visit]] to [[Algeria]]. He will visit [[Souk Ahras]], the birthplace and home of [[St. Augustine of Hippo]], namesake of the [[Augustinian Order]], which Pope Leo is a part of. [https://apnews.com/article/africa-pope-leo-algeria-muslim-migration-ccf9458e288db4355f359ddf56668caf (AP)]
*[[Bahrain–Iraq relations]]
**The [[Bahrain]]i [[Ministry of Foreign Affairs (Bahrain)|foreign ministry]] summons the [[chargé d'affaires]] of [[Iraq]] over "continued malicious drone attacks" against the country and other [[Gulf Cooperation Council]] states from Iraqi territory. [https://www.aljazeera.com/news/2026/4/13/bahrain-summons-iraqi-envoy-as-pro-iranian-attacks-persist-in-gulf (Al Jazeera)]
*[[Iran–Russia relations]], [[Russia in the 2026 Iran war]]
**[[Kremlin press secretary]] [[Dmitry Peskov]] states that [[Russia]] is prepared to receive [[Iran]]'s [[enriched uranium]] as part of a potential agreement with the [[United States]], following unsuccessful [[Islamabad Talks|negotiations]] between Iran and the U.S. [https://globalnation.inquirer.net/318076/russia-offers-to-take-in-irans-enriched-uranium (AFP via ''Philippine Daily Inquirer'')]

'''Law and crime'''
*[[Gaza war protests]]
**[[Gaza war protests in the United States]]
***Demonstrators in [[New York City]], U.S., are detained during a [[Criticism of Israel|anti-Israel]] protest calling for an end to [[United States support for Israel in the Gaza war|U.S. aid]] to [[Israel]]. Protesters also oppose the [[Protests against the 2026 Iran war in the United States|US-Israel strikes in Iran]] and Lebanon war. [https://www.reuters.com/world/us/dozens-detained-new-york-city-protest-over-us-arms-sales-israel-2026-04-14/ (Reuters)]
*[[Corruption in Spain]]
**[[Begoña Gómez]], wife of [[Spain|Spanish]] [[Prime Minister of Spain|prime minister]] [[Pedro Sánchez]], is charged with [[influence peddling]] and corruption in the private sector. [https://www.bloomberg.com/news/articles/2026-04-13/spanish-prime-minister-s-wife-charged-with-influence-peddling (Bloomberg)]
*[[Lafarge scandal]]
**A [[Judiciary of France|court]] in [[Paris]], [[France]], convicts cement company [[Lafarge (company)|Lafarge]] and several former executives, including former [[CEO]] [[Bruno Lafont]], for [[Finances of the Islamic State|financing]] the [[Islamic State]] and other [[List of armed factions during the Syrian civil war|Syrian armed groups]] between 2013 and 2014, imposing fines, [[asset forfeiture]], and [[Prisons in France|prison]] sentences. [https://www.aljazeera.com/news/2026/4/13/french-court-rules-cement-giant-lafarge-guilty-of-funding-syrian-terrorism (Al Jazeera)]
*Three people are killed and four more injured in a [[mass shooting]] during a family dispute inside a [[mosque]] in [[Khinjan District]], [[Baghlan Province]], [[Afghanistan]]. [https://amu.tv/235012/ (Amu TV)]

'''Politics and elections'''
*[[2026 Beninese presidential election]]
**Provisional results reveal that [[Ministry of Economy and Finance (Benin)|finance minister]] [[Romuald Wadagni]] won in a [[landslide victory]] with 94% of the vote. [https://www.reuters.com/world/africa/benins-finance-minister-wadagni-wins-presidential-election-with-94-landslide-2026-04-13/ (Reuters)]
*[[By-elections to the 45th Canadian Parliament]]
**Following victories in three federal by-elections, the [[Liberal Party of Canada]] wins a majority government nearly a year after the [[2025 Canadian federal election]]. [https://www.reuters.com/world/americas/canadas-carney-set-win-majority-government-special-elections-2026-04-13/ (Reuters)]

'''Sports'''
*[[Boycott of Russia and Belarus]]
**[[World Aquatics]] says that they will allow athletes from [[Belarus]] and [[Russia]] to compete under their national anthems and flag. [https://www.espn.com/olympics/story/_/id/48474195/world-aquatics-drops-restrictions-russian-athletes (ESPN)]
